For Sale:
One older mobile home currently residing in Liberty Acres Mobile Home Park (near NE 108th Street and NE Cookingham Road). It includes two bedrooms, one bath with shower, living room, kitchen, dining room, laundry facilities, and covered deck. This home comes with all current appliances (including refrigerator, gas stove, microwave, pots and pans, silverware, toaster, window air conditioner, Maytag washer and dryer, kitchen table and 3 chairs, couch, TV and stand, bed, dressers, computer desk, and all of the current owner's lifelong collection. It has a dog run off of the porch for a dog that has issues with getting up and down steps (last picture). It also includes a shed and a fenced yard (very rare in a mobile home park) as well as a battery powered lawnmower (not started in two years). Current lot rent is $789.34 which includes trash pickup weekly. It does not include ANY utilities (lights, water, natural gas, or internet/TV packages).
Multiple items have been replaced, including the kitchen faucet and bathroom lavatory faucet, most of the main water lines under the home, water heater, and shed roof. The roof of the home was seal-coated a number of years ago and probably needs to be done again. There are no leaks to my knowledge as of this time in the home or the included shed. The home had vinyl siding added a number of years ago and is in good condition. A clear Missouri title will be exchanged once funds have been processed and cleared. A huge notebook with instruction manuals for multiple items will be included with the sale.
This would be a great mobile home for someone buy and use for hunting on some remote acreage. I am not aware of what the costs would be to move a home such as this one.
The contents of the home will need to be gone through by the buyer and either donated or disposed of by the buyer AT THEIR EXPENSE.
I will answer any questions to the best of my ability concerning this home. I have been doing the basic maintenance for a number of years due to the advanced age of the owner.

items.description:
Taking offers. Not much of a car guy. Really don't know much about it. These retail for $350 online
Please call or text 91three 3zero3 851zero
The Power Control Module 90710S is a Jet Performance aftermarket chip designed for Dodge and Jeep vehicles, specifically the Stage 2 for modified engines, boosting horsepower and torque by optimizing fuel, air, and spark timing for performance parts like intakes and exhausts, requiring 91+ octane fuel and a 180° thermostat for best results.
Key Features & Functionality:
Product: JET Performance Module, Part #90710S (Stage 2).
For Modified Engines: Caters to vehicles with performance upgrades (intakes, headers, exhausts).
Performance Gains: Dyno-tested to increase horsepower (up to 25HP) and torque, improving throttle response and acceleration.
Technology: Uses Dynamic Spectrum Tuning (DST) to optimize air/fuel ratio and ignition advance across the entire power band.
Installation: Simple plug-and-play into the ECM (Engine Control Module).
Requirements for Stage 2 (90710S):
Fuel: 91 octane or higher.
Thermostat: 180-degree thermostat.
Exhaust: Free-flow exhaust system.

Desi is a black leopard draft cross, his sire was appaloosa/friesian and his dam is a paint draft cross. He is fancy enough in movement to do english or western, whatever way you want to take him.
More than happy to arrange a facetime to see him live.

High-Percentage Foundation Depth: At 90.72% FQHA Foundation bred, this sire brings back the old-school, big-bodied Quarter Horse structure. This structure blends flawlessly with the stocky, muscle-dense conformation of the Haflinger.
True Working Longevity: Free from modern arena-bred frailties, this line is highly valued by trail riders, packers, and ranchers who need sound, dependable horses that can travel all day on rough terrain and keep their feet.
Guaranteed Premium Color: Sired by a blue roan foundation stallion out of chestnut dams, these foals inherited the roan gene alongside a black base coat. This combination results in a striking, high-expression Bay Roan coat that turns heads in any pasture.

Used set of five American Racing ATX Series AX192. Tires are General Grabber AT2. Plenty of tread life left. Comes with all lug nuts, 4 lock lugs and key. These rims are discontinued and no longer available from American Racing. I had these on a 2000 Chevrolet Blazer and the rims will fit a variety of lug patterns.
Text or call 816-8sevenseven-7two43
American Racing ATX Series AX192 Blade is a one-piece cast aluminum wheel designed for trucks and SUVs, featuring a bold 8-spoke design with available satin black. Popular in 17-inch with a +18mm offset, these wheels offer a durable, lightweight construction with hidden lugs.
Key Specifications & Features
Finish Options: Satin Black.
Construction: One-piece cast aluminum.
Size: 17x8.5 and with 5, 6, and 7-lug patterns.
Offset: +18mm.
Load Rating: 1133 kg (approx. 2500 lbs).
Styling: 8-spoke design with a hidden lug nut look.
Common Fitments
The AX192 fits a variety of 5 lug, 6-lug and 7-lug trucks and SUVs, including 6x115/6x120, 6x127/6x132, and 7x150 bolt patterns. They are frequently used to provide a modern, aggressive aesthetic to light-duty trucks.
Construction & Design
The wheels are built for both street and light off-road use, utilizing aluminum to maintain a lower unsprung weight.

items.description:
The Thermal Dynamics Stak Pak 70A Model is a highly durable, industrial-grade plasma cutting and gouging system known for its robust construction, multi-gas capability, and heavy-duty metal removal performance. It is designed for high-precision cutting on a variety of conductive metals.

Cutting Capacity: Capable of severing materials up to 1.5" to 2.75" thick, with a genuine pierce and cut rating typically around 1" thick.

Auto-Switching Input Power: Often features multi-voltage auto-sensing, allowing the unit to toggle between single-phase and three-phase power inputs across common voltages (e.g., 230V or 460V).
Gouging and Scarfing: Exceptional material removal rates that make it ideal for weld removal, heavy gouging, and beveling.
Duty Cycle: Industrial-level duty cycles (e.g., 70% duty at 70 Amps max output), preventing overheating during heavy production use.
Common Applications:
Because of its raw power and rugged design, the Stak Pak is routinely utilized in heavy fabrication, railroad maintenance, scrap processing, shipbuilding, and commercial welding operations.

items.description:
I'm selling my 2014 Harley-Davidson Electra Glide Ultra Limited (FLHTK) with a bit over 42K miles.
My wife and I decided to buy this last year, and while we've had fun with it, but we've decided "the Harley thing" is not "for us," so we're selling it. I purchased it in WI and immediately rode it back to Rapid City with zero issues. I did a "three hole" oil change at 40K (I rolled over 40K on the way home) and replaced clutch and brake fluids. The only "issue" I've had was one of the o-rings on the fuel tank outlet (a common issue).
This machine is in excellent condition! It's about as clean a machine as you could imagine for 40K miles. There is one blemish on the fuel tank where probably a boot lightly scraped it, and one of the exhaust tips rubbed the ground at some point. Tires are still in great shape. (The apparent "blemishes" on the fairing are just bugs.)
Has rear air suspension, electronic cruise control, the H-D Boom audio system, wired for headsets, amazing headlight / DRLs, etc. Will include a trickle charger and lightweight dust cover. Feel free to ask any questions.
Happy to show & run; test ride will require a valid driver's license. Clear title in hand. We currently live in Rapid City, SD, but we frequently travel back to/through KC, and I would be willing to bring it for a serious buyer.
Only possible trades would be for a Can-Am Spyder or a Beta 390; please don't ask about anything else.

NEO QLED is an evolution of Samsung’s QLED (Quantum Dot LED) technology. It uses Quantum Dots, which are tiny semiconductor particles that emit precise colors when illuminated, to produce vibrant and accurate colors across the screen
. Unlike traditional QLED TVs that use standard LED backlighting, Neo QLED employs Mini LEDs, which are much smaller and more numerous, allowing for finer control of brightness and local dimming
. This results in deeper blacks, brighter whites, and improved contrast, especially in HDR content.

items.title: K-SPEC Western Electric 111C Stereo Transformer Processor | Mix Bus Color Box
items.ai_notes: [K-SPEC Western Electric 111C Processor] Niche high-end studio gear for audio professionals.
items.description:
The K-SPEC Western Electric WE111C Stereo Transformer Processor is a handcrafted, completely passive studio processor built around a carefully selected pair of vintage Western Electric WE111C transformers.
Unlike many transformer boxes that simply house a pair of WE111Cs, this processor provides extensive control over transformer behavior through selectable 600:600 or 150:600 impedance, three-position loading (Open / 620Ω / 150Ω), true hard-wire bypass, and a three-position Ground / Soft Lift / Full Lift system with individual Zobel stabilization networks.
Few passive WE111C processors offer this level of control, allowing you to explore a much broader range of transformer behavior than a fixed-configuration design.
This is no random pair of WE111C transformers. K-SPEC processors are built around carefully selected transformer pairs. The transformers installed in this processor measure approximately 99.56% matched (<0.44% difference) based on documented winding resistance measurements. Unlike many listings that simply state “matched,” this processor includes the measurements to support that claim.
Construction emphasizes low-noise wiring practices, premium Canare internal wiring, point-to-point construction, 90° transformer orientation to minimize magnetic coupling, and long-term serviceability. A printed wiring diagram is included for documentation and future service.
Features
● Genuine Western Electric WE111C transformer pair
● Approximately 99.56% matched (<0.44% difference), based on documented winding resistance measurements
● Independent Left and Right 600:600 or 150:600 impedance selection
● Three-position transformer loading: Open / 620Ω / 150Ω
● True hard-wire bypass
● Ground / Soft Lift / Full Lift switching
● Individual Zobel stabilization networks
● Premium Canare internal wiring
● UV-printed aluminum front panel
● Printed wiring diagram included
Ideal for stereo mix bus processing, mastering chains, stems, synthesizers, keyboards, acoustic instruments, bass, electric guitar, and other line-level applications where the classic sound of Western Electric WE111C transformers is desired.
Each K-SPEC processor is individually assembled, thoroughly tested, and verified prior to shipment.

items.description:
The majority of people on Craigslist are trustworthy, but scammers frequently go after buyers and sellers. I'm only posting this once in the category to help spread awareness.
Use these tips to stay protected:
Common Scam Red Flags:
Deals priced much too low along with rushed urgency
Bad spelling/grammar, missing details, or copied stock images
Pressure to take the chat off-site to email, texting, or WhatsApp
Asking for payments via wire transfer, gift cards, Zelle, Venmo friends & family, Bitcoin, or Western Union
Schemes where they overpay with counterfeit checks or money orders then ask you to send money back
Phony escrow companies or fake "Craigslist protection" services
Safe Trading Rules:
Never pay or send money until after you get the item and check it carefully
Always meet in a public spot (police station parking lots recommended) and take someone with you
Handle local sales with cash only – examine the item first, then complete payment
Continue using Craigslist’s built-in anonymous email feature
Keep your personal details private at the beginning
Listen to your gut feeling. Leave if it doesn't feel right. Report any shady contacts and stay safe!

It has an aftermarket reed valve breather system and does NOT leak a drop of oil. It is stable at speed, comfortable, predictable and fast. Clean title from the state of Arkansas in my name.
The only two flaws in my opinion are: The original gas tank was too badly rusted out so it was replaced with a gas tank that is cosmetically a bit rough. Rather than repaint it, I opted to keep the original paint and striping scheme in case I wanted it professionally redone later. The interior of the tank has been flawlessly relined. The electric starter clutch often slips so I simply have used the kickstarter. There is not a single time that it has not started on the 1st or second kick.

items.title: 2011 BMW R1200RT
items.ai_notes: [2011 BMW R1200RT] High-mileage motorcycle; reliability is a plus, but the mileage will deter some buyers.
items.description:
Original owner, purchased new in 2011. No mechanical issues of any kind. Mostly all of the 120,000 miles are highway miles. The bike was used mostly for long distance travel and has been to all four corners of the continental U.S. My reasons for selling are that I bought another R1200RT, same year, fewer miles and I simply do not need two.
This motorcycle is BY FAR the best, most reliable motor vehicle that I have ever owned. After the break in period, the oil and filter have been changed every 3000-4000 miles. I use Mobil 1 synthetic exclusively. Valves have been checked or adjusted along with complete fluid change every year. The last valve adjustment was done in August of last year.
List of problems I’ve had: At 5,000 miles the right control switches failed and were replaced under warranty. At 100,000 miles the rubber swingarm boot cracked and was replaced. Last year the alternator failed and was replaced. It is on it’s 3rd battery.
I would NOT hesitate to get on this motorcycle and ride to ANY point on ANY map.
It will need new tires in the next 4000-5000 miles. It will probably need new brake pads in the next 5000-10,000 miles.

items.title: Electra Townie 7D (by Trek) - Custom Cruiser
items.ai_notes: [Electra Townie 7D Cruiser Bike] Well-maintained cruiser bike from a reputable brand.
items.description:
This is a good condition, used Electra Townie 7D cruiser bike.  Sold at Trek stores, it's a great bike for around the neighborhood with the kids, for pub crawls, parades, or just for showing off.  It has a forward placed crank that alllows the rider to have their feet flat on the ground when stopped and still be in the proper position when pedaling (Flat Foot Technology).
The bike has some tall bars and a bigger soft saddle.  Cables were replaced to fit the bars.  Accessories include a water bottle holder, a bell on the handlebars, and the factory kickstand.
The bike has been completely gone through, fresh grease, bearings adjusted, paint shined up and touched up in a few spots.  It's ready for the next rider.  Probably best fit for those in the 5'5" to about 6'1' range.
Located in south KCMO, message me with questions or to come see/purchase this bike.

items.description:
Unit#-307125
Due to our high demand for our Low Pricing structure RVs, our inventory is constantly changing which makes it difficult to continue to update real actual pictures of the RV; so please text me your email address for actual pictures and miles of this unit#.
If this RV is not available, I will email you what's currently in our reconditioning process where you can reserve one under your name.
This RV has a Ford triton E450 V10 engine that can pull up to 5000lbs.
It comes with a Onan 4k generator, gas stove, microwave, frig, all the holding tanks, bathroom w/shower.
This unit can sleep up to 7-8 guests
Cruise America's primary business is renting out Class C motorhomes. They are rented out for about 5 years and my corporate office in Arizona decides when to retire them from our rental fleet and designates a few to be sold to the public. It goes through our refurbishing process where we start by taking off all of the Cruise America graphics, it gets a whole new paint job on the camper and we put the original Majestic graphics back on. Then, we go in the inside to check the appliances; all the appliances need to be in working condition before it's put out for sale. We check the tires/brakes and if they have less than 50% of life on them, they will get new tires/brakes. We even put a 3mo/3,000 powertrain warranty on the engines good at any Ford dealership in the nation.
We are located in Kissimmee FL just south of Orlando and 20 minutes from away from the Orlando International airport (MCO) and we are the largest Cruise America RV sales/refurbishing location in the US eastern market. For that reason, we have a Huge Selection of model Class C inventory from 19ft to 30ft RVs.
Why wait to be put on a waiting list when you can start your adventure now.
For over 12 years, I've served the whole eastern part of the US. And since 50% of my customers come from out of state or out of town, many of our customers travel great distances to take advantage of our sale prices. Most have never seen the motor home that they are interested in. We have them place a refundable $500.00 credit card deposit by phone. They arrive here with the balance due in the form of a bank cashier’s check. If the motor home does not meet their expectations, the deposit is credited back to their account. If they approve and it is what they expected, we proceed with the purchase. RV financing options are available, please request for details if interested.
Cruise America presently has a “Fly and Buy” program that will reimburse your flight up to $300.00 or train travel to this location (Kissimmee, FL).
In Lieu of the Fly/Buy program, Cruise America has a One-Way Car Rental program. You can rent a car one way to our location and Cruise America will send you a rebate check for your car rental up to $300.00 after you take the RV home. You can use any car rental company such as Hertz, Avis, or Budget.
We have RV financing or USAA bank if you're a veteran (ask for details).

Kissimmee, FL 34744

The grueling new ACFT is neutral across all genders and age groups, and includes a strength deadlift, standing power throw, hand-release push-ups, sprint/drag/carry, leg tuck, and a 2-mile run.

From wide-angle landscapes to medium-telephoto portraiture, the FUJINON XF 16-55mm F2.8 R LM WR lens offers unparalleled versatility and superior image quality. This weather-resistant zoom lens boasts a constant aperture of F2.8 across its entire focal range, equivalent to 24mm at wide-angle through to 84mm at medium-telephoto.
Engineered with an advanced optical design, this lens controls various forms of aberration to deliver edge-to-edge sharpness across the entire zoom range. The inclusion of a newly-developed Nano-GI (Gradient Index) coating technology effectively inhibits ghosting and flare, producing clear, high-quality images.
Ideal for a wide range of shooting scenes, this lens covers everything from the wide-angle 24mm equivalent suitable for landscape photography, to the medium-telephoto 84mm equivalent, perfect for capturing stunning portraits.
The XF16-55mm lens is equipped with a linear motor, ensuring fast, quiet autofocusing for a comfortable shooting experience. Its weather-resistant and dust-resistant finish allows it to function in temperatures as low as -10 degrees Celsius, making it a reliable companion for the FUJIFILM X-T1 premium mirrorless camera, and other compatible models, to create a fully weather-resistant system.
In order to achieve best-in-class image quality, this fast standard zoom lens comprises 17 elements in 12 groups. This includes three aspherical lens elements to control spherical aberration and distortion, and three ED glass lens elements to reduce lateral chromatic aberration (wide-angle) and axial chromatic aberration (telephoto).
The lens also features Fujifilm's unique HT-EBC (High Transmittance Electron Beam Coating) applied to the entire lens surface, ensuring ghosting and flare are controlled for sharp, clear images. Additionally, the newly developed Nano-GI coating technology reduces ghosting and flare for diagonal incident light.
The lens also boasts nine rounded aperture blades that create a smooth, circular bokeh. Combined with an X Series camera body with Lens Modulation Optimiser (LMO) technology, the lens performance is further enhanced, producing images with edge-to-edge sharpness and a realistic three-dimensional effect, even at small apertures.
The lens also offers high-speed, quiet autofocus thanks to the Linear Motor and an Inner Focusing System. The fastest AF speed of 0.06 seconds, combined with the near-silent shutter sound, allows for discreet photography in quiet locations.
The FUJINON XF 16-55mm F2.8 R LM WR lens is not only high-performing but also boasts a high build quality with a metal exterior and focus and aperture rings for a refined finish. The lens mount is made from brass for improved strength. The AF+MF function enables seamless manual focusing, allowing for fine adjustments after autofocusing on the subject.
This lens is approximately 60% of the weight of a full-size system when combined with a camera body, significantly reducing the burden on the photographer and ensuring ease of use. Whether you're a professional photographer or an enthusiast, this lens is a valuable addition to your photography gear, offering high-quality images, versatility, and durability.

items.title: BMW 303M 20" Staggered Wheels & Tires Set
items.ai_notes: [BMW 303M 20-inch wheels and tires] Good price for a set of OEM BMW wheels; these are specific to certain chassis.
items.description:
I have a used set of 20" BMW 303M wheels with tires. These are the factory wheels for the 2008-2015 7-Series BMW, and the 2011–2017 "Gran Turismo" 5-Series GT BMW.
Factory specs:
Front Wheels: 8.5Jx20"
Offset: ET 25
Rear Wheels: 10.0Jx20"
Offset: ET 41
Bolt Pattern: 5x120mm
Center Bore: 72.6 mm
They can fit on other BMW's, here is some information:
7-Series (F01/F02) & 5-Series GT (F07)Fitment: Perfect OEM fit. No spacers, hub rings, or modifications are needed to bolt these right on.Tire Specs: Standard staggered sizes are 245/40R20 (Front) and 275/35R20 (Rear).
5-Series (F10)Fitment: Direct swap without needing spacers. The aggressive offset gives the F10 a wide, flush stance.Tire Specs: To avoid rubbing issues on the F10, you should run a slightly smaller profile: 245/35R20 (Front) and 275/30R20 (Rear).
3-Series & 4-Series (F30 / F32)Fitment: Highly aggressive. Because Style 303M fronts are 8.5" ET25, they will poke slightly past the fenders. You will need to roll your fenders or use narrower, stretched tires to avoid rubbing.Tire Specs: Run 225/35R20 on the front and 265/30R20 on the rear, and consult a local shop for a professional alignment.
Newer BMWs (G-Chassis / 5x112 Bolt Pattern)Fitment: Not a direct bolt-on. Modern G-chassis BMWs use a 5x112 bolt pattern. You will need custom conversion adapters (e.g., 5x120 to 5x112) and need to account for the added thickness of the adapter to prevent your wheels from poking too far.
They do have curb rash on the wheels. I will include a DIY wheel repair kit if you want it.
I have not tried mounting these, and I would highly recommend replacing the tires. The tires are Dunlop SP Sport Maxx GT DSST and they do have some tread left on them, these tires are not a great tire. Lastly I do not know the status of the TPM sensors. I would recommend replacing those at the same time when installing new tires.
Cash Only. Near Swope Parkway & US71.
Thank you

items.title: Weigh Safe Trailer Hitch American Flag
items.ai_notes: [Weigh Safe 2.5-inch shank drop hitch] High-end towing accessory, listed as never used. Condition is open_box as it is out of original retail packaging.
items.description:
American Flag Weigh Safe Hitch Limited Edition
Retails for $389.00 + tax, you can buy the regular one on their site for $340.48 with their code.
I bought another one in a different drop and you can provide the code on the keys to get any additional locks you want. This one has never been used but I love the one I have. Super easy to switch between the ball sizes and height.
This is a 2.5” or 2 1/2” shank (fits a 3/4 ton GMC/Chevy and I believe the 3/4 ton Fords) with a 6” drop
The Weigh Safe Drop Hitch is the best aluminum drop hitch on the market. This hitch features our signature built-in gauge that measures tongue weight so you never have to worry about an unbalanced and unsafe load again. Crafted out of solid, aircraft grade aluminum, the Weigh Safe Drop Hitch is not only sleek but offers a Towing Peace of Mind with every towing journey.
Constructed of aircraft grade aluminum, the Weigh Safe Drop Hitch is rated up to 18,500lbs Max Gross Trailer Weight and 2,200lbs Max Tongue Weight.
Comes with two stainless steel tow balls, 2″ and 2-5/16" sizes. Swapping out the tow balls is as easy as pulling a pin and can be done in seconds! Simply remove the slider and pull out the ball retaining pin to release the tow ball. A 1-⅞” tow ball can be purchased separately if you need a smaller size.
Towing a different trailer and need to adjust the height of the slider? No problem. With the Dual Pin Slider Lock, height adjustability has never been easier. Add in the option to use the Weigh Safe Drop Hitch in the rise position and you have the ultimate adjustable hitch. This hitch can also be flipped around and stowed out of the way when not in use, saving shins everywhere.
Need more security? A Hitch Locking Pin is keyed alike to your adjustable ball mount. You read that right, ONE key for everything!
The Weigh Safe Drop Hitch is the one and only trailer hitch with a built-in scale that measures load before you hit the road, resulting in a much safer and enjoyable towing experience. Before this ball mount, gauging your trailer’s tongue weight was a hassle. You had to rely on inefficient bathroom scales, make a trip to the weigh station, or purchase a separate tongue weight scale. But with the Weigh Safe’s built-in scale, measuring your tongue weight is as easy as coupling your trailer to your ball mount. After verifying that your drop hitch receiver is the correct height, simply hook-up your trailer to the Weigh Safe ball mount just as you would any other ball mount. The Weigh Safe Drop Hitch comes in 4-inch, 6-inch, 8-inch, and 10-inch options.
Tongue weight refers to the weight that the fully loaded trailer exerts downward on the hitch ball of the tow vehicle. Tongue weight is typically 10 percent – and should not exceed 15 percent – of your gross trailer weight. For example, a 10,000-lb trailer should have a tongue weight between 1,000lbs and 1,500lbs. You can adjust the tongue weight of your trailer by removing or adding cargo or redistributing the load on the trailer. The tongue weight should not exceed the capacity of your tow vehicle, your hitch, or any of your towing components.
Simply put, too little tongue weight can cause trailer sway, and too much tongue weight can cause the tow vehicle to perform poorly. You may have difficulty steering, gaining traction, or braking when driving a setup that has too much weight pushing down on the rear of the vehicle. Ultimately, towing with an improper tongue weight can cause you to lose control of your vehicle or cause your trailer to separate from the vehicle.

items.title: Early 1900s Seth Thomas Adamantine Mantel Clock
items.ai_notes: [Seth Thomas Adamantine Mantel Clock] Circa 1905 mantel clock; appears complete and functional.
items.description:
Often called a 6-column Adamantine clock this clock boasts a faux marble finish, ivory-colored columns, decorative caryatid figures, and ornate metal feet.  This clocks shows characteristics of Seth Thomas clocks made roughly in the 1898-1915 period.  Estimated this clock was manufactured around 1900-1908, with approximately 1905 being a strong possibility.
Clock has its original dial, all six columns present, decorative metal figures and feet complete.  Case finish is original, attractive, and shows normal wear for a period piece like it.  The dial has some age discoloration, which is normal.  The clock runs and chimes correctly.
Photo has been included showing the back inside brass movement.  The movement is authentic Seth Thomas movement made in Thomaston, Connecticut.  Another photo shows the original paper instruction label even though it shows some wear.
Adamantine mantel clock, Seth Thomas, Six-column, Eight-day time and strike, Original label, Original Pendulum, Made in USA, and Circa 1905. This is a very nice, complete example of a classic Seth Adamantine mantel clock. It's one of the more desirable early 20th-century American mantel clocks and a valuable piece to add to any collection.

items.description:
30's Knife PAIR Remington DuPont STAG RH73 with Deer Etching & Handmade German Pig Sticker
This is an Authentic 30's, not a reproduction, vintage Remington Dupont RH-73  Fixed Blade Hunting Knife along with the HTF Original Sheath which has "Remington-Dupont MFG" Mark. Knife has Genuine Stag Antler Handle, Carbon Steel Blade with "RH73 Made in USA" mark on one side, and "Remington" mark on the other with worn Etched Deer Scene on Blade. Knife measures approximately 8-1/4" overall, Blade measures approx. 4-1/8". The Knife is Superb for a decades old ... "a true piece of American craftsmanship and sporting history that collectors actively seek."

LARGE FLOOR STANDING FIGURAL LAMP , ITALY.
Measures  55" tall, globe is 12" in diameter
Girolomo Pieri immigrated to Philadelphia from Italy in the 1940s. Initially, he earned a living working for a small business selling such things as piggy banks. He and his brother, Silvano, eventually bought the business and expanded it to include items, like lamps and statues, that allowed Girolomo to use his ceramic skills. The business grew to be a factory and studio that took up a city block. Over the years, many other immigrants from the hill towns of Bagni Di Lucca in Italy worked for the business. The Pieri family sold the business in the early 2000s, as mass production and imports from China affected the domestic artisan market.

items.title: 8,000 lbs. Doosan G35S-5 Forklift - Low Hour
items.ai_notes: [Doosan G35S-5 forklift] Heavy industrial equipment; resale is slow and requires specialized buyers.
items.description:
What's up everybody! Hope y'all had a great Independence Day. I started thinking over the weekend about getting rid of some big stuff to save up some money and decided it's a pretty good time to part ways with my Forklift. I haven't been needing it nearly as much as I did when I bought it and I know there's peeps out there looking for one.
This is a Doosan G35S-5 from the year 2014. I didn't rack up all of the hours on the meter, I bought it used, but it has 3,677 at the time of me typing this.
It can lift up to 8,000 lbs. on 48" forks, uses a three-stage mast to lift up to 185", and uses LPG fuel to make it all happen. It came to me with solid pneumatic tires, which have been great when I needed to drive off the pavement and pick up a load on some bumpy terrain.
When I got this ride, the owner told me he'd throw in a power-train guarantee for the first 30 days. And since I never needed to use it, I'm going to pass on the offer to anyone looking to take this one off my hands. If you need help getting the forklift to you, I have an option in that case for a little extra.
Shoot me a message with the reply button and I'll answer any question you got for me. Talk to ya soon!

items.title: Articulating Bendi B30 Forklift from 2016
items.ai_notes: [Bendi B30 articulating forklift] Niche articulating forklift with high hours; very specific buyer base.
items.description:
I don't think I've ever seen one of these guys on here myself, so I might have a bit of a rare forklift here for craigslist. This is an Articulating forklift, meaning you can rotate the direction the forks are facing within a 180 degree radius. It's from a brand called Bendi and they call this model the B30 or the 42AC-180D. From my experience driving this one around, it's definitely made to slip into the more narrow isles that your average forklift can't squeeze into.
It can haul up to 3,000 lbs. of weight and lift it up to 216" on a 3 stage mast. It's using a 48V Battery to power it up, so this is an electric forklift.
It has 12676 hours registered on the meter, so it's definitely a seasoned professional at this point. Despite it working exactly the way it should, if you happen to run into any issues with the power train within the first 30 days of owning it, I'll get you taken care of at no extra cost.
It's not the newest or freshest forklift you'll find on here, but I know someone's been looking for a skinny legend to add to their warehouse. Hit me up with the reply button any time with any questions you have. I'll be waiting!

STRENGTH, PRECISION, AND PERFORMANCE
Whether you're outfitting your home gym, equipping a commercial fitness center, or seeking portable fitness equipment for your travel adventures, Rogue Ductile Iron Kettlebells are a staple component. Available in weights from 9LB (4KG) to 203LB (92KG), our kettlebells offer a wide range of options to suit every fitness level and goal. Unlock a world of possibilities with kettlebell training. From powerful swings to snatches, cleans, jerks, Turkish get-ups, farmer’s carries, and more, Rogue Ductile Iron Kettlebells enable you to train a variety of movements and exercises for strength, power, and endurance.
WHY DUCTILE IRON?
Unlike gray cast iron, these kettlebells are crafted from ductile, or nodular cast iron, renowned for its exceptional strength and durability. While gray cast iron is strong, it is much more brittle than ductile cast iron. The nodular graphite within the ductile cast iron creates additional structural integrity with increased tensile and yield strength. This material ensures that these kettlebells are virtually indestructible, providing you with a reliable fitness tool that withstands the test of time.
THE ROGUE DUCTILE IRON KETTLEBELL DIFFERENCE
Original Rogue Design: Our kettlebells are an original Rogue design using ductile iron gravity casting in a single piece mold.
Superior Strength: Crafted from ductile iron, our kettlebells offer unmatched structural integrity and resilience.
Precision Finish: With meticulous attention to detail, any excess material around the seams in the molds are removed by skilled craftsmen, while the bottom of the bell is machined to be flat and to meet the weight tolerance.
Enhanced Grip: Our carefully calibrated powder coat finish strikes the ideal balance between grip and comfort, allowing for a firm grip while facilitating smooth rotations in the athlete’s hand.
A HISTORY OF STRENGTH
Originating in Russia in the 1700s, kettlebells have evolved from measuring weights to indispensable tools for strength and power training. At Rogue, we honor this legacy by continually innovating and refining our kettlebell designs to meet the demands of modern athletes and facilities. Rogue was the first company to implement color-coded bands at the base of the handle; this has since become the industry standard. Over the years, we have made additional subtle changes to the design to optimize both the shape, balance, and finish of our kettlebells, resulting in the best general use kettlebells for home and commercial use.

Metzler tires have low miles but due to their age the tires will need to be replaced.
No trades please. Open to offers but first with $2250 gets it. Priced to sell.
Because the bike has been garaged for some time and is not registered or safety inspected, buyer will have to trailer the bike to their location.
We're in south KCMO near Leawood at State Line and Red Bridge road.

items.title: 2001 Danelectro Hodad Baritone (strung as Bass VI)
items.ai_notes: [Danelectro Hodad Baritone Guitar] Unique vintage-style baritone guitar, currently set up as a Bass VI.
items.description: This is my Danelectro Hodad Baritone bought new 25 years ago, which I restrung in Bass VI tuning (EADGBE, octave below guitar).  No adjustments were made at the time so retuning to baritone would not be difficult.  I think around 29-30" scale so it works well if you want it as a Bass VI, vs shorter scale baritones.  It has a silver sparkle finish, and standard Danelectro hollowbody construction.  The switching system is somewhat unique...three lipstick pickups going to a 6 way rotary (N, NM, M, MB, B and NB) with a separate switch that throws all of them on, and the combinations are in series, not parallel, so you get more of a thicker humbucker like tone when the pickups are combined in series.  Concentric V/T pots.  No case/bag.  You can do a lot of things with this (as a 19yo I recorded a whole minialbum using this for both bass and guitar), but it would be great for things where you want a throaty baritone like sound (spaghetti western, or the Cure).  I'm just trying to stop being a gear hoarder and clean out a room full of gear so I thought this one might need a new home.  Any questions, just ask.

Attachment, lightweight, fifth wheel hitch is designed for any OE or aftermarket undermount gooseneck towing system and is unlike any other hitch of its kind on the market today.  Strong, American steel vs. those weaker aluminum models and still only 64 lbs. lifting weight, the SuperLite 1P hitch gives you confidence that you're towing with the best!
The #2600 SuperLite fifth wheel hitch is designed to tow gooseneck trailers and typically mounts to a single point, standard 2-5/16" ball.  These types of mounting systems are available as an aftermarket product or come OE equipped (factory direct).
We converted the fifth wheel trailer's king pin to a ball and turned the hitch plate into a funnel, making it the easiest hitch on the market to hook up.  Totally visible from the cab, you simply drop the trailer's converted ball anywhere on the diameter of the funnel and lower your trailer!  The Remote Latch system locks/unlocks the ball into funnel and keeps you out of the bed–and there are no secondary locking devices to engage.

items.title: MENS MEDIUM BICYCLE GT
items.ai_notes: [GT Road Bike] Seller provides a long rant about bike industry trends; bike appears to be a decent mid-range road bike.
items.description:
IF YOU ARE READING THIS AD I STILL HAVE THIS BICYCLE, I PROMPTLY REMOVE LISTING ONCE AN ITEM IS SOLD.
In my 50 plus years of bike building I've come to realize most people have no idea about bike buying. Most of the time they look for a name brand. Almost all bikes now are made in Taiwan or mainland PRC by one of 3 different companies. Bikes are like any other consumer product in that the brands have to come up with different things to hype trying to sell new bikes. The 3 biggest trends in the last decade are gravel, as in frames that accommodate fatter wheel/tire combos, disc brakes, really helpful in wet or muddy conditions, but unnecessary if riding in regular condition. Sram has made a fortune convincing everyone eliminating the front derailleur and installing a dinner plate sized rear cluster in superior to a well adjusted front D and a wide range of gears to accommodate a smooth gentle transition of ratios. The reason 11 and 12 speed clusters on racing bikes have gained popularity is the smooth transition between gears and finding just the right cadence for any condition. A 12 speed with a 2 ring compact crank has a 24 gear selection. My 3x10 set up has 30 combinations for finding the cadence sweet spot. The last trend is electric which obviously mine is not. One innovation I did use when I built this is using tubeless tires. Tubeless in addition to being mostly flat proof also allow running at much lower pressures that with a tube as "pinch flats" are not a issue. Lower pressures allow better contact with the pavement actually increasing pedaling efficiency and roll smoother over rough pavement and even gravel. One does not need a dedicated "gravel bike" to ride on gravel, more marketing BS. My 2013  hydroformed frame is just slightly heaver than a carbon one but infinetaly more durable. The carbon front fork does reduce overall weight but most importantly damps road vibration. Hydroforming is the process on moving molten aluminum inside the frame to strengthen joints while moving it away from center of the tubes to allow flexibility and smoothing out the ride. Hydroformed aluminum is superior to carbon except for the status.The tiny weight difference only matters is you're racing. The low mileage on this bike was due to my hobby of bike building that had 30+ bikes in my "stable". The rides i did on this was in very hilly terrain riding with people on high end Treks and Specialized. I effortlessly left them behind on every hill due to my gearing. Many bike snobs, married to the idea that anything bigger than a "corncob" rear cluster was "cheating", but nowadays even the pros are riding 11/34 rears. The regular push bike frame and geometry has changed little int ht 210 years bikes have been produced. The difference if there is any between a 2013 frame and a 2026 is minuscule. As far as parts, the rear Shimano 105 derailleur on this is brand new with 0 miles. I prefer a "low normal" style derailleur but because it shifts opposite of "regular" D's and can be confusing to someone not used to it, I installed this new 105. The entire bike is built with obsessive compulsive detail. The easily removed bags, a $500extra, make this really attractive as a commuter bike.
HYDROFORMED ALLOY FRAME W/CARBON FORK
SHIMANO 105 TRIPLE HOLLOTECH CRANK W/OUTBOARD BEARINGS
SRAM 11X34 LIGHTWEIGHT REAR CLUSTER
SHIMANO 105 5700 BRAKE LEVERS/SHIFTERS
SHIMANO 105 FRONT AND REAR DERAILLEURS
SHIMANO RS-20 WHEELSET W/SCHWALBE ONE TLR 25 X 700 TIRES
KMC "MISSING LINK" PREMIUM CHAIN
FIZIK PREMIUM SADDLE
JANOVELO QUICK RELEASE FRONT HANDLEBAR AND LARGE CAPACITY SADDLEBAG
I built this bike from the frame up using premium parts and is the equal in performance of bikes in the $3000 range. I'm offering it for sale at less than1/3 of what it cost to build, and although it is upper entry level, you would not outgrow this bike for many years. Geared to climb the steepest hills with ease
It comes as pictured with both handlebar and saddlebag for making wardrobe adjustments on long rides, or carrying something home from the store. The handlebar bag has a pushbutton quick release to leave it home when on shorter rides. The bags alone are a $500 value.
The 54cm medium frame has a standover height of 29.5 in. I'm 5'8" and the bike fits me perfectly.
This bike is very low miles, in new condition with no signs of wear.
The following link might be of interest to anyone shopping for a bike and thinking this brand is better than that brand when in fact 95% of bikes today are made by just three different Taiwanese companies and the only difference is the paint job and decals. In this case the impression is GT is not as good as Trek because GT is mass marketed and Trek is only sold in bike shops. http://jorgeusbiker.blogspot.com/2018/02/are-original-bikes-not-made-in-taiwan.html

items.description: It is a silver colored 2012 VW Jetta TDI Wagon with close to 156,000 miles on it. We bought it around 120,000 as a temporary transitional car for college but never got used for that as my kid started using another car. The car has been great for me and does have two small dings on the front bonnet due to stones/pebbles hitting it on high way. The moon roof works but inner cloth sun shade is stuck. All leather. The interior and the exterior are consistent with its age with some wearing. Until about a month back it was in working perfectly. Now it shows code P2016/2015 for the intake manifold sensor and there is also noise coming from the flywheel. I do still drive it for local errands. No other codes or DPF issues. I would love to keep it but have to let it go as we are making space and probably a good diesel enthusiast will appreciate the car more. Clear Kansas title.  Being sold as is. Would prefer the buyer pick it up on a trailer. Has Douglas tires installed about 4 months ago. Prefer cash or the vehicle will be released only after the cheque/check clears.

items.title: Black and Decker 10" bandsaw.    Modified for 240 volts
items.ai_notes: [Black and Decker 10" bandsaw] Modified with a different motor and plug; tracking can be tricky.
items.description:
Up for sale is a tinkerers dream.   I bought this saw with the idea of re sawing wood for my lathe work.  It had a 1/5 hp motor as is usual with these tools.   Way under powered.  So I installed a 1/3 hp condenser motor from a A/C condenser.  So much better.   But it was 240 volts.  A small issue so I installed a long extension cord that plugged in to my welding outlet.   Or a drier outlet also works  fine.
So it uses a 56 1/8" blade.  Saws fine but being 3 wheels, can be a bit tricky on tracking and tension.  Included is extension cord, three blades,  miter gage and the old motor as it still works fine.
I purchased a vintage Delta 10" cast iron band saw to replace it.
If needed and you bring a drier plug with you, I can replace the welder plug with that one.  You can,  however, replace the motor with the old one, but it is just a dog on sawing, so just saying......

items.title: Vintage Camp Fire Girls Vest
items.ai_notes: [Vintage Camp Fire Girls vest] Niche collectible; some loose beads noted.
items.description:
This vintage Camp Fire Girls ceremonial vest is a stunning piece of mid-century Americana and textile folk art, dating to the 1960s. Crafted from deep navy blue wool felt, the vest serves as a vibrant, hand-decorated record of a young girl's achievements and dedication. The front and back feature over 180 wood "Honor Beads." These beads represent the Seven Crafts of the Camp Fire program, including Home, Health, Camp, Hand, Nature, Business, and Citizenship.  Additionally, on the front is the Bluebird patch and a plastic disc representing 3 years of membership.  Both the front and the back have symbolic felt appliques.
This piece is ideal for collectors of vintage youth organization memorabilia, textile historians, or those who appreciate authentic 1950s/60s folk art. Unlike mass-produced uniforms, the highly individualized nature of the beadwork makes this a one-of-a-kind artifact. The felt remains sturdy and the colors are bright, making it a museum-quality addition to any archival collection or a standout display piece for a vintage enthusiast.
Please note that there are some loose beads.

From the Johnson website: "The Johnson Millennium is the world's first Tube Integrated Modeling Amplifier. Analog, digital, and tube circuitry, combined to give you the convenience of modern technology coupled with the tones of vintage circuitry. Johnson Amplification has real tubes. Easy access to the sounds of your favorite tones is what Tube Integrated Modeling Amplification is all about. There is no easier way to access those tones than with a Johnson amp. items.description:
Though strongly associated with east africa many Zanzibar chests or 'Sandook'(s) were actually produced in Gujaret, India before being exported across the indian ocean. These chests were prominently displayed as symbols of status by wealthy families with the degree of ornamentation in proportion to the families rank or status. This beautifully carved Laurel leaf wreath motif symbolizes victory, endurance, nobility, and honor.

items.title: Vintage Heathkit AS-101 / Altec Lansing Valencia-Style Speakers
items.ai_notes: [Heathkit AS-101 Speakers] High-end vintage audio equipment; requires a specific audiophile buyer.
items.description:
For sale is a pair of vintage Heathkit AS-101 speakers, built by the owner in 1972. These are the desirable Heathkit version of the classic Altec Lansing Valencia-style speaker, using Altec Lansing components and drivers clearly marked Altec Lansing.
The Altec Lansing Valencia is one of the classic home hi-fi speakers from the golden age of American audio. It is closely related to Altec’s legendary Voice of the Theatre speaker line, which was originally designed for powerful, clear, highly efficient theater sound. The Valencia brought much of that same horn-loaded Altec character into a furniture-grade home speaker system suitable for serious home listening.
These Heathkit AS-101 speakers deliver the classic Altec sound: open, dynamic, efficient, and very natural. They produce a large, room-filling soundstage with excellent vocal presence, strong center imaging, and a wide sense of space. Music sounds lively and effortless, especially with jazz, vocals, acoustic music, classic rock, orchestral music, and tube or solid-state amplification.
Details:
Pair of vintage Heathkit AS-101 speakers
Altec Lansing Valencia-style design
Built by the owner in 1972
Altec Lansing drivers clearly marked
8 ohm speakers
Crossovers rebuilt in 2025
Cabinets refinished in 2010
Classic horn-loaded Altec sound
Large, open soundstage
Clear vocals and strong dynamics
Excellent choice for a vintage audio system or dedicated listening room
Speakers: Altec Lansing 15 woofer, 10-1/2 pound magnet assembly.  High frequency driver, 13 ounce Alnico V magnet with 800 sectoral horn.
The rebuilt crossovers are a major plus, since crossover age is one of the most common concerns with vintage speakers from this era. The cabinets were refinished in 2010 and present well.
These are serious vintage speakers for someone who understands Altec Lansing, Heathkit AS-101, Valencia-style speakers, or Voice of the Theatre heritage.
Local pickup only. Buyer should bring proper help and a suitable vehicle, as these are large and heavy speakers.  The speakers weigh 101 pounds each.
Serious inquiries only.

items.title: Chevrolet Cavalier OEM keys & knockouts
items.ai_notes: [1982 Chevrolet Cavalier OEM key set] Original unused OEM key set for a 1982 Chevrolet Cavalier.
items.description:
For Sale:
One matched set of 1982 Chevrolet Cavalier OEM GM ignition and door/hatch keys with knockouts. These were the original set of keys that were never used on the car and were not found when the car was traded in. There are two (2) GM ignition keys (and 1 copy) and two (2) GM door/hatch keys (and 1 copy). Aftermarket color-coded keys had been cut and used for simple visual identification. Also included is a key fob from the original selling dealership, Classen-Morse Chevrolet, originally in Midtown, K.C. MO and later moved to 9201 Metcalf in Overland Park, KS.
Knockout Codes for keys were the following:
28F9
27M7
Asking $40.00 cash only please for entire key set pictured (the 2 copies are not in the pics. They were found after the pics were taken). No warranty, implied or otherwise, on keys. Items sold as/is. Milk crate used to take pictures not included in sale. Call before 8:00 pm for information. Can be shown during daylight hours by appointment only.
These keys would be a goldmine for someone with a survivor or restored vehicle with a worn set of keys or aftermarket replacements. Research I have found states that for a 1982 model the primary (square) key (also known as a B46) should have a J stamped at the base of the key shaft and the secondary (round) key (also known as a B47) should have a K stamped at the base of the key shaft. These keys may also fit other year Cavalier ignition and door locks or other GM vehicles. Please verify your vehicle requirements prior to purchasing these items.

This vintage copper cup set of 6 is a charming piece of history crafted by the Aluminum Goods Manufacturing Company, a prominent Wisconsin-based manufacturer known for producing metal goods for both World Wars and high-end housewares in the 1950s and 1960s. items.description:
*** POTTED CATALPAS less than 2 Feet tall $25 EACH*** 3 foot Catalpa $35 and 4 foot Catalpa $55.  Empress Trees potted 1 foot tree $55 on the last two pictures.. PLEASE DO BRING CASH we do not carry change. I have a very limited stock on hand this year. Please check the pictures and note that the Catalpas with large leaves. The pictures of the mature trees are examples. Catalpas grow very fast!! during the Fall season the trees start to lose their leaves after they have become yellow. You can plant until the ground freezes.  I can schedule appointments to see the trees on weekdays or week ends. Thank you.
Fast Growing Shade Tree With Amazing Spring Blooms.
Related to the Royal Empress tree, the Northern Catalpa tree, Catalpa Speciosa, is also a fast growing tree with amazing spring blooms. It would be outstanding as a unique, ornamental shade tree.
Large, showy white, trumpet-shaped flowers will put on quite a show in late spring. What a site this tree becomes when the huge white flowers create a stunning contrast against the solid green background of foliage! As an added bonus, the flowers attract hummingbirds!
As a member of the Bignonia Family, it is related to Trumpet Vine, Royal Paulownia, and other species of Catalpa, all of which are known for their showy flowers. This deciduous tree is also known as Hardy Catalpa, Western Catalpa, Cigar Tree, and Catawba-Tree.
The huge, heart shaped leaves can be as big as 12 inches across! They not only help block the sun on hot summer days, but also makes the chore of raking leaves a lot easier.
Farmers introduced Northern Catalpa to Ohio in order to produce large amounts of relatively lightweight timber for fence post since the wood is very resistant to rotting. Very tolerant of tough conditions, it withstands wet, dry, alkaline soils and hot, dry environments, but prefers moist, deep soil; should be planted in sun or partial shade.
For a hardy, fast-growing shade tree with ornamental spring blooms, you can't go wrong with the Northern Catalpa. Catalpas make great dwarf trees if pruned every year, but not bonsai trees due to the large leaves.
Fishermen: Grow your own Catalpa worms (the larval stage of the catalpa sphinx moth) are plump, black-and-yellow caterpillars highly prized by anglers as premium live bait, often called "catfish candy". They are the only caterpillar species that feed on catalpa trees and are known for their voracious appetites.

items.ai_notes: [Numark NDX 400 CD/USB Player] Older digital DJ gear, demand is niche.
items.description:
Play and scratch from MP3s, CDs and USB flash drives.
NDX400 is an advanced, touch-activated scratch MP3/CD player that can also play from a USB flash drive. Numark’s Anti-Shock™ buffered skip-protection technology keeps the music playing even when vibrations might cause other players to skip. Three hot-cue points and a large, touch-sensitive scratch wheel give you the tools to express your creativity.
NDX400 is a flexible, slot-loading player that not only plays standard CDs, but it can also play MP3 CDs for lengthy playback from a single disc. Additionally, it can play from a USB flash drive for even more music-format flexibility. For easily navigating through folders on MP3 CDs and USB flash drives, NDX400 has an easy-to-read text display.
NDX400 has vinyl-style braking for stopping playback just like a record, and reverse mode that enables you to incorporate even more special vinyl effects. NDX400 has seamless looping for creating and integrating loops in instant remixes. Single, continuous, and programmable playback modes enable you to control playback order and create custom playlists. NDX400 also has fader start, which starts NDX400 playing when you move the crossfader on a compatible mixer.

items.ai_notes: [PhoneSoap XL UV Sanitizer] Specialized sanitizing device; niche utility.
items.description:
*TABLET NOT INCLUDED*
PRODUCT DETAILS:
- UV sanitizer kills 99.99% of germs.
- Safely sanitizes anything that fits inside.
- Big enough for the Apple iPad Pro, and other large tablets.
- Works with any tablet operating system (Apple iOS, Android, etc.)
- Charging ports allow it to act as a universal charger for devices.
UV-C LIGHT KILLS GERMS:
The four UV-C lamps in PhoneSoap XL produce a very specific wavelength of light which encompasses your tablet and passes through the cell walls of bacteria and viruses to impair their DNA. Once their DNA is compromised, the cells die and can no longer cause infections or disease. The best part is that PhoneSoap XL is big enough to sanitize anything from pacifiers to remote controls. Let there be light!
PHONESOAP XL IS EFFECTIVE:
Four powerful UV-C lights and a reflective inner surface allow the light to surround your phone and ensure the destruction of any unwelcome guests. While PhoneSoap XL was created to focus on tablets, anything you put inside will be safely sanitized. If it fits, it cleans. PhoneSoap XL only takes 15 minutes to completely sanitize* your phone, and a blue indicator on the front will let you know when the sanitizing is complete. Take a look at the results and see for yourself!
CHARGE ANY TABLET:
PhoneSoap XL is universal! Designed to fit even the largest tablets, such as iPad Pro, and engineered to charge any tablet. PhoneSoap ships with a 2.4A USB port on the back of the device. Using the charging cable provided with your own tablet, you can charge your device while it is inside PhoneSoap XL.
For example, if you have an iPad, take the Lightning cable provided by Apple, plug it into the back of the device, then thread it through the pass-through port on the bottom of the device. You will pass the cable through the back and into the inner sanitizing space. Once inside, you can leave your cable there and plug it into your tablet any time you want to charge. Plugging your cable into your tablet will allow it to charge at normal speeds. This works with any device charging cable such as a Micro USB, Lightning cable or even Apple’s old 30-pin cable.

items.title: LOCAL GRASS FED – GRASS FINISHED BEEF!!
items.ai_notes: [Grass-fed beef] Local farm-raised beef sold by the pound.
items.description:
GRASS FED – GRASS FINISHED BEEF!! $11.80 per pound
More Omega-3's! There are 2 to 4 times the amount of these "good fats" in pasture raised beef.
Higher amounts of Vitamin E which helps reduce the risk of heart disease and cancer!
We are selling beef from a steer raised on our property near Oak Grove, MO - grass fed and grass finished. We are not in the business of selling livestock, just want some good healthy meat raised in the correct way - on grass pasture. It doesn’t cost us a lot more to raise another steer along with the ones we keep for ourselves. We are selling a steer in quarters, halves or as a whole.
This your opportunity to get some quality, local, farm-raised beef for a bulk price. Great tasting steaks, roasts and ground beef.
Most of the ads for buying beef are based on hanging weight (the weight of the carcass after it has been prepped and ready to butcher). This can be confusing, because you pay a certain amount based on the weight of the beef, then you pay an additional amount to the processor. What is your total price?
We try to simplify the process and you know exactly how much the beef in your freezer costs. We do this by setting a price per pound of the beef you take home.
We pay the processing costs directly to the processor – you only pay for the packaged beef you take home at $11.80 per pound.
$11.80 per pound for steaks, roasts and ground beef.
Expect to take home 75 to 120 pounds of meat in a ¼ beef.
About 140 to 240 pounds of meat in a ½ beef.
*******
Processing includes:
Cutting to your specifications, aging 14-21 days, wrapping in 1 mil clear poly wrap and then white butcher paper. Packages have customer name, date processed and item name on package. Ground beef is double ground and packed in 1lb, 1 1/2lb or 2lb poly bag. Meat is quick frozen.
You choose the cuts you receive. This includes steaks, roasts, and ground beef, etc. The processing will be done at Nadlers in Wellington, MO.
The beef will be ready in approximately a month and will have had time for aging and processing.
We can deliver in the Metro area for $25 - $50, depending on the area.
For a 1/2 of a beef you would need approximately 8 to 10 cubic feet of freezer space.
Call or text. Happy to answer questions - If I don't answer, Leave a message and I will call you back.
You can also use the email - it may take longer for me to respond. Thanks for your interest!

items.title: Elio Merchandise - Shirt, flyer and bumper sticker
items.ai_notes: [Elio Motors Merchandise Lot] Collectibles related to a defunct car project; value is highly subjective to collectors.
items.description:
I have for sale very rare items for a car that never got to production! The car was an Elio and it was going to be the highest mileage car manufactured with an estimated mileage of 84 mpg. Paul Elio was an automotive engineer that was trying to launch his invention. I, like thousands of other interested individuals paid $1000 to be put on an "All In" waiting list for the early released cars. Gasoline became cheap and the Elio project kind of died on the vine.
I ended up with what you see: a 2XL Elio T Shirt (Made in America), an unused bumper sticker and a sales brochure. These are very rare and if you are a car buff you will know that. I have included in my pics the proposed Elio car pics and the items I have for sale. I was, and could still be, a very interested person to own an Elio car. The car held 2 people in front and back of each other. Do some homework and check up on Elio and fall in love with the concept. You will NOT find these items offered very seldom. Collectors, you must have these for your automobile collections.
I will consider delivery if the distance is reasonable. Also, BTW - I am NOT selling a car!
I am asking $50 for all of the items or a very serious offer. If you are seeing my listing, the items are still available. Call or text me with any questions or to make an offer. Randy 913 6three6-6766 . Thank you for looking at my listing. Happy Motoring!

items.ai_product: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer
items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer] Seller did not provide a price; highly specialized historical railroad item.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.title: FOUR FLAGS RALLY VINTAGE MOTORCYCLE RIDE! FREE!
items.ai_notes: [Four Flags Rally event] This is an announcement for a motorcycle rally event, not an item for sale.
items.description: The RiverCity Ramblers' TWENTY-FOURTH ANNUAL Four Flags Rally, a real road ride like most owners of vintage motorcycles only daydream about, will start at 9:00 A.M. on SATURDAY, 7/11/2026, at the Harp's Food store (park on the gravel and grass east of the store or in the FAR SOUTHEAST corner of their parking lot) at 1107 South Main Street across from the Casey's General Store on OK Highway 20 just west of downtown Jay, OK. It's GPS coordinates are: latitude: 36* 25' 9"; longitude: -94* 48' 23". You may leave your truck parked there. Casey's sells non-ethanol gas, and please start with your bike full of gas. Riders of all PRE-1990 vintage, street-legal motorcycles of UNDER 501cc (NO EXCEPTIONS, PLEASE) are welcome on this approximately 195-mile one-day tour through four states (OK-KS-MO-AR). This event is designed to be a safe yet challenging ride for medium-size vintage motorcycles. Our ride will include a quick stop at Jim Serage's great Second Kick Cycle Works Museum in Grove, two crossings of Grand Lake, a ride under the bluffs along the Elk River at Noel, MO, and many miles in the foothills of the beautiful Ozark Mountains. We will take a cooldown break - swimming optional - at the Grand Falls of Shoal Creek on the west side of Joplin. We will eat lunch at Van's Steakhouse in Baxter Springs. We need to MAINTAIN 55 MPH for several stretches of U.S. Highways, so this may not be the ideal ride for bikes of under 125cc. Your food and gas should be your only costs for the ride. A sag wagon will be provided to haul tools, gas, water and inop bikes. Everyone who rides the Four Flags Rally will receive a commemorative ride button and a nice 8.5" X 11" color photo of his choice from among vintage motorcycle subjects. To encourage the riding of older, truly vintage bikes, riders of all 1969 or older bikes will receive a 1960s-vintage issue of Cycle World magazine. Several trophies will be awarded, and all riders will be entered into a drawing for nice prizes, which include the book History of Japanese Motorcycles 1945-2007 (the definitive reference source for Japanese bikes), a motorcycle wheel balancer, sound recordings from the 1966 Isle of Man TT races and more. We will have an earlybird drawing for those entered by 8:30 A.M. For more info, call Larry @ 918-2five8-2four00.

items.title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
items.ai_notes: [Antique UPRR railroad level] Collectible railroad tool; no price provided.
items.description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

items.location: Mention this ad for a discount!
items.ai_notes: [Acoustic panels] Professional acoustic treatment; no price listed, likely a service or custom build.
items.description:
Acoustic Panels & Bass Traps for Studios — Not Foam
Text 323-640-1655
You’ve invested time and money into quality gear—interfaces, microphones, monitors, instruments, and outboard equipment. The missing piece in many studios isn’t more gear, it’s how the room sounds once that gear is in use.
Foam only treats a narrow part of the frequency range. It can reduce some high-frequency reflections, but it doesn’t address midrange buildup or low-frequency problems that cause rooms to sound uneven and unreliable.
Acoustic Panels and Bass Traps are designed to control sound across the full frequency range. By absorbing reflections from parallel walls, ceilings, and corners, they help reduce peaks and dips that make mixes, recordings, and playback inconsistent.
With proper acoustic treatment, speakers translate more accurately, microphones capture cleaner detail, and decisions come faster with fewer revisions. This saves time, reduces frustration, and allows your equipment to perform the way it was intended.
Our Acoustic Panels and Bass Traps are built using Ultacoustic technology, designed by a Berklee-trained professional musician, and constructed with 100% premium polyester and dense internal absorption materials selected for predictable performance in real rooms.
Panel and bass trap options include 1", 2", 3", 4", 6", 8", and 9" panels, along with Triangle Bass Traps and Column Bass Traps. Different formats and thicknesses are used depending on room size, layout, and speaker placement.
We also provide all mounting hardware options, LED strip lighting, recessed LED lighting for ceiling clouds, and 49 fabric color choices so treatment integrates cleanly into the room without compromising the look.
All products are manufactured in Los Angeles. We provide delivery and installation from San Diego to San Francisco, including Sacramento, and ship nationwide for clients outside our service area.
For clients installing themselves, we include clear instructional installation videos to support proper placement and mounting.
We also offer 1-on-1 consultations to help determine appropriate panel types, quantities, and placement so treatment is effective without over- or under-treating the room.
Text 323-640-1655

items.title: 2001 Toyota Corolla Spacio 7 Passenger Wagon 1.5L / Auto
items.ai_notes: [2001 Toyota Corolla Spacio] This is a JDM import vehicle, which is a niche market and difficult to value accurately without specific mileage and import documentation.
items.description:
Desperate and challenging times in the automotive world are windows of opportunity to create brilliant solutions! Just look at Volkswagen Beetle, Honda Civic and Mazda Miata!
But let’s start at the beginning, in mid-1990s Toyota had to reinvent itself in Japan that was struck by the recession at that time period. To make the task even more challenging, since Toyota historically maintained several dealership networks in Japan with models exclusive to certain outlets, it had to create a replacement for the outgoing Corolla Wagon that was both more interesting and priced below the aging Sprinter Carib mini-RV, sold by a more premium Toyota Netz stores.
After many sleepless nights, Toyota engineers have created a product that although evolutionary on paper, was nothing short of revolutionary given how awfully boring most compact cars became in the late 1990s. They took a Corolla sedan, added tall hatchback body and voila - 1st generation Toyota Spacio was born!
What is Toyota Spacio?
Toyota Spacio is a minivan built on the platform that carried 1998 - 2002 Toyota Corolla/Geo Prizm in US. If you look at it from the underneath - front suspension is identical to your Grandma’s Corolla! However conservative Japanese customers remained loyal to the reliable 1.6L 4A engine from early 1990s that went into Spacio’s engine bays vs. more modern 1.8L power plant from US sourced Corollas built in West Buffalo, WV that wasn’t very reliable! Spacio was built to last!
But let's fast forward to 2nd Generation Toyota Corolla Spacio. It no longer needed to fill in for Toyota Corolla Wagon, in 2000 Toyota has introduced a brilliant Corolla Fielder wagon to cater to traditional wagon buyers in Japan and taxicab operators elsewhere in the world! 2001 Corolla Spacio mission was more defined and focused - to entice late 1980's cabover, mid-engine minivan owners to upgrade to a smaller, more fuel-efficient vehicle that offers the convenience of 4 conventional doors, compact size, seating for up to 6 occupants and plenty of interior versatility and space for furniture, small appliances or recreational gear, as well as mini camper for a single person or a couple!
Drivetrain specifications:
Focus here was the efficiency and dependability, however highly dependable 1.5L Toyota 1NZ-FE Dual Overhead Camshafts engine with Variable Valve Timing technology that features 16 valves design and rated at 110hp is quite sufficient to keep up with traffic. Transmission is the same Toyota A340E unit, as in a million or so 2000 - 2016 Toyota Echo/Yaris, Scion xA / xB. In short, it does the job!
Interior design:
And this is where Corolla Spacio shines bright!
Consider these features:
• Clean, yet ergonomics dash! My Gen X, 48 year old eyes find the instrument cluster very easy to read compared to the overly complicated modern cars.
•  Imagine the front passenger seat that folds flat to accommodate larger/longer cargo objects or provide a work surface for iPad/laptop.
• Abundant storage throughout the cabin - cubby atop of the dash, tray for the passenger use above the glove box, all doors equipped with bottle holders, under seat storage, deep center pockets on both sides of center console.
• Minivan like pass-through between front seats.
• 2nd row seats tumbles forward as a single unit, creating a spacious cargo compartment.
• 2nd row 60/40 split-folding rear seats with sliding mechanism and center armrest with cup holders and tray.
• 3rd row seats folds flat into the floor, freeing up room in the trunk for a grocery run, strollers/bikes or antique market finds.
• Speaking of bikes, middle seat can also be flipped up to put kids bikes directly behind front seats Honda Fit- style and still use 3rd row seats.
• Maximum Load Length: 64.5 inches with 2nd and 3rd row completely folded.
Specifications:
• 1.5L engine and 4 speed Automatic Transmission, same as US market Toyota Echo/Yaris/Scion xB.
• Air Conditioning
• ABS with EBD
• Dual Airbags
• Split folding, 3 passenger, 2nd row seat middle seat with arm rest/tray table.
• Flat folding 3rd row, 2 passenger seat
• Power windows, power folding mirrors, central locking.
• Door rain guards.
• Extra clean interior.
• Only 25K miles.
Available late August 2026
Priced at $8,750.00 FIRM, no trades!

items.title: Horse Pasture Boarding
items.ai_notes: [Horse Pasture Boarding] This is a service listing for horse boarding, not a sale of a physical good.
items.description:
Hard keepers welcome - I have had quite a few arrive on the lean side and they seem to flourish here!
I have two spots available in my pasture. I am mainly looking to provide a retirement pasture for older horses who need a quiet place to relax and graze all day. Current permanent residents are 21, 22, 25, 29, 30, and 34, all very laid back and friendly. It is located just south of Harrisonville.
$350 per month and brome rounds are included all winter long and your bill will not change. Includes a senior feed in the base rate, as well as any fly masking/blanketing/etc. Does not include farrier or vet - I have Caleb Quinn out every 6-8 weeks, he charges $50 for a trim, I meet him and catch/hold horses so you don't need to be there unless you want to be.
I can feed supplements as needed, and I can separate horses for feed to ensure supplements will go only to your horse. I can also do alfalfa pellets and soak feed - very open to whatever keeps your horse happy and healthy! Supplements are provided by the owner of each horse.
There is a 13'x36' run-in shed, as well as many trees for shade and shelter. The pasture is fertilized every spring to keep it in excellent condition. Property is also double fenced.
This is my personal residence, these horses are seen multiple times throughout the day and given excellent care. I've worked at National level show barns, as well as been an equine vet tech at a surgical facility. I also have a bachelor's degree in Equestrian Science.
Vaccines and negative Coggins required before your horse comes onto the property. Vet and farrier costs not included in board price per month.
You are welcome to come see the property prior to boarding your horse here, as well as come visit any time you'd like. I don't have set hours, just ask that no one comes to visit in the middle of the night/use common courtesy.

Wirebrushed texture with low gloss. The wirebrushing pulls out the natural grain and gives the surface a lived-in, textured feel that hides everyday wear far better than a high-gloss smooth finish. Dark Forest is a rich, deep brown tone that works with just about any trim or cabinet color.
Install it your way. Engineered construction means you're not locked into one method. Nail, staple, glue, or float it, whichever fits your subfloor and your budget for install labor.
Radiant heat compatible. If you've got in-floor heating or are planning it, this floor is rated to handle it, something solid hardwood generally cannot do.
5 inch width, 4-side eased edge. Wide enough to look modern and open up a room, with eased edges that give you that subtle beveled look between boards without collecting dirt in a deep V-groove.

items.description:
Hi all.
Make offer.
I’m honestly in need of cash and this goes with nothing in my place.  I think it’s an easy flip for someone.  Make an offer.
Here is the chat GPT info on it but feel free to do your own info.  I’m not on FB or EBay so here I am.  I am honest and know little but need cash.   Feel free to make offer.
The Weller Dickensware “White Buffalo” (Burgess-decorated) pieces fall into one of the stronger collecting tiers of Weller art pottery, so values are actually pretty well documented through auction sales.
Here’s the real-world pricing based on recent auction comps and dealer sales:
⸻
💰 💰 Weller Dickensware “White Buffalo / Burgess” Value
🟡 Typical market range (most common condition)
* $300 – $650
* This is what most pieces actually sell for on eBay or general auctions
⸻
🟢 Strong example (good detail, clean, clearly marked)
* $650 – $1,200
* Applies if:
* Clear Native American / buffalo imagery
* Good size (8–14 inches typical)
* No cracks or repairs
* Strong glaze and detail remaining
⸻
🔥 High-end auction examples (specialist buyers)
* $1,200 – $2,500+
* These are usually:
* Exceptional condition
* Rare figural scenes
* Strong provenance or early marked examples (like “Dickens Ware / Weller / Burgess” impressed pieces)
Example reference: similar Weller Dickensware Native American vases have sold around $500–$1,000 at auction depending on condition, and higher when large or especially detailed  .
⸻
⚠️ Low-end / damaged examples
* $100 – $300
* If:
* Hairlines, chips, or restoration
* Weak or unclear decoration
* Smaller or less detailed pieces
⸻
📊 What drives YOUR specific piece’s value
For your exact “White Buffalo Burgess” type:
Biggest value factors:
* ✔ Clear Native American / buffalo subject (good demand)
* ✔ “Burgess” attribution (adds collector interest)
* ✔ Impressed Weller Dickens Ware mark (important authenticity)
* ✔ Size (bigger = more value)
* ✔ Condition (huge swing factor)
⸻
⚖️ eBay vs Auction reality
🟦 eBay (true market value)
* Usually sells: $400 – $800
* Auctions can spike higher if 2 collectors compete
🟧 Auction house (KC or national)
* Hammer price: $500 – $1,200 typical
* Your net after fees: $350 – $800
⸻
🧠 Straight answer
If your piece is:
* intact
* clearly marked
* and has good “White Buffalo” imagery
👉 The realistic value is:
💵 $450 – $900 retail/market
💵 $350 – $700 net after consignment fees (typical)
